claim_ceiling: This file defines deterministic scenario stimuli and owner-routed observations. It does not encode an event clock or simulate physical/resource/service trajectories; those remain with Symtropy and specialist owners.

scenario_families.stimulus: The shared hub loses upstream electrical supply while the household-local fallback remains available.
required_observations: first service-floor breach or preserved floor
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: No household service is declared lost or preserved from the grid/hub event alone.

scenario_families.stimulus: One household-local fallback fails while the commons remains available.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: A functioning hub does not erase a household-local essential-floor failure.

scenario_families.stimulus: The shared water treatment or distribution path fails while reservoir/system stock remains positive.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: Bulk stock or reservoir level is not proof of household tap delivery.

scenario_families.stimulus: The shared provider and a declared household-local fallback depend on the same failure domain.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: Declared independence must be supported by qualified dependency evidence.

scenario_families.stimulus: The hub is online but the resident-declared route/access mode is inaccessible.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: Geographic proximity or facility availability is not service access.

scenario_families.stimulus: Simultaneous demand exceeds the shared service capacity and a queue or unmet-demand boundary is reached.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: A neighborhood aggregate cannot compensate for an individual resident queue/floor breach.

scenario_families.stimulus: The central controller and external network are unavailable while local manual fallback is required.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: Cloud/controller availability is not assumed for essential local fallback.

scenario_families.stimulus: A shared asset is running but critical spare-part availability or qualified maintainer access is unknown.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: Unknown repair capacity is not infinite or qualified repair capacity.

scenario_families.stimulus: The designated maintainer cannot safely or physically access the shared asset.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: No restoration time is inferred from nominal spare-part stock.

scenario_families.stimulus: A second fault occurs after apparent restoration but before the native stable-recovery window has elapsed.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: A transient restoration is not stable service recovery.

scenario_families.stimulus: A proposed allocation would consume resource below the declared protected reserve floor.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: A capacity optimizer cannot spend a resident-protected reserve.

scenario_families.stimulus: The same source event or meter receipt is submitted twice as a resource transfer.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: Duplicate telemetry cannot create additional community resources.

scenario_families.stimulus: A transfer uses a unit that differs from its source or destination account without an explicit conversion contract.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: No implicit conversion or comparison across incompatible units.

scenario_families.stimulus: A household data-access request occurs at or after the consent revocation time.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: Previously granted consent does not authorize new access after revocation.

scenario_families.stimulus: A resident disputes an allocation decision and invokes the published appeal path.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: The optimizer cannot resolve moral priority or close a resident appeal.

scenario_families.stimulus: The shared hub is degraded while a subset of households simultaneously experiences local equipment failure.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: Hub availability and neighborhood average do not substitute for each household outcome.

scenario_families.stimulus: Grid or bulk utility supply is restored but a downstream household service remains degraded.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: An upstream restored event is not proof of household service recovery.

scenario_families.stimulus: A resident revises an essential task/service requirement after a design or allocation decision has been recorded.
scenario_families.claim_ceiling: Changed requirements invalidate dependent decisions only, not unrelated evidence.
